title.en: Nurses and Midwives (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2006

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Nurses and Midwives (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2006 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2006.

2. The following offences may be compounded by the Singapore Nursing Board in accordance with section 43A(1) of the Act:
(a)any offence under section 18(7), 19(4), 26(1), 27(3), 28(3), 29(2), 35, 36(5)(b) or 38(2) of the Act; and
(b)any offence under regulation 23(2) or 52(3) of the Nurses and Midwives Regulations 2012 (G.N. No. S 119/2012).
[S 120/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
